consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Budapest; Australian Embassy Vienna
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Budapest headed by an Honorary Consul. The office provides some consular assistance but can't issue emergency passports or perform notarial acts. Get in contact before you visit.
